overview.description: The Grayscale Bitcoin Covered Call ETF (BTCC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long btc, short usd currency. The fund is actively managed, seeking current income via a synthetic covered call strategy on Bitcoin ETPs through options trading. It aims to capitalize on the performance of Bitcoin while providing monthly distributions to investors BTCC was launched on Apr 2, 2025 and is issued by Grayscale.
